prompt: A street checkpoint between apartment blocks by day, seen from the side at street level. A thin waist-high metal boom gate arm with alternating dull dark-red and grey stripes crosses the road. Behind it stand figures in dark blue-grey riot gear with full helmets and visors down so no faces show. On the near side a short queue of ordinary civilians in winter coats waits with heads bowed and shopping bags in hand. Flat grey overcast light. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
